cues: Opens with "I'll proceed with the 10-step procedure using the guidance in the method specification", which refers to a written methodology directly.

The plan has exactly 10 numbered sections (Classification, Dependencies, Key decisions, First slice, Phases, Validation, Cross-cutting, AI Layer, Exceptions, Deferred). This looks like a fixed template, not a natural layout.
It uses a reversibility scheme (R1/R2/R3) with a default, assumption, validation and revisit trigger for each decision. It also labels budgets as REQUIREMENT, ASSUMPTION or BASELINE.
A Phase 0 "production first end-to-end slice" has an exit check, and there is a validation gate table with hypothesis, method, threshold, evidence and unlocks fields.

It includes a mandatory "AI Layer: N/A" section and an "Exceptions: None" section. It ends with a Self-Check of checkmarks that restates methodology rules, such as "Rework runs widest first" and "all four cross-cutting moves".
